```{python}
#| label: setup
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

from _lib import (
    DATA_DIR,
    get_release_dir,
    get_release_base,
    load_par_visit_candids,
    load_identifiers,
    load_excluded_release_candids,
    load_additional_excluded_pscids,
)

try:
    from matplotlib_venn import venn2, venn3
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    HAS_VENN = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_VENN = False

RELEASE_DIR = get_release_dir()
RELEASE_BASE = get_release_base()

# ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def rc_to_iids(rc_set):
    """Expand a set of release_candids to IID level (both C and M)."""
    return {f"{int(rc)}C" for rc in rc_set} | {f"{int(rc)}M" for rc in rc_set}


def _try_csv(path, **kwargs):
    """Read a CSV if it exists, else return None."""
    if path.exists():
        return pd.read_csv(path, **kwargs)
    return None


# ── load identifiers & reference sets ──────────────────────────────────

identifiers = load_identifiers()
par_candids = load_par_visit_candids()
exc_rc_excel = load_excluded_release_candids()      # Excel exclusion (RC-level)
exc_pscids_csv = load_additional_excluded_pscids()   # HBCDexclusions.csv (pscid-level)

# Map CSV pscid exclusions → release_candid
exc_rc_csv = set(
    identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(exc_pscids_csv), "release_candid"]
    .dropna().astype(int).unique()
) if exc_pscids_csv else set()

all_exc_rc = exc_rc_excel | exc_rc_csv
all_exc_iids = rc_to_iids(all_exc_rc)

# ── Pipeline stage data ────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Stage 1 — Raw HBCD cohort (from July2025 transfer)
raw_fam = _try_csv(
    DATA_DIR / ".." / "HST_HBCD_Transfer_July2025" / "HBCD_analysis" / "hbcd.fam",
    sep=r"\s+", header=None,
    names=["FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO"],
)
raw_pscids = set()
if raw_fam is not None:
    raw_fam["iid_part"] = raw_fam["IID"].astype(str).str.split("_").str[2]
    raw_fam["pscid"] = raw_fam["iid_part"].str[:-1]
    raw_pscids = set(raw_fam["pscid"].dropna())

# Map raw pscids → release_candid via identifiers
raw_rc = set(
    identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(raw_pscids), "release_candid"]
    .dropna().astype(int).unique()
) if raw_pscids else set()
raw_iids = rc_to_iids(raw_rc)

# Stage 2 — QC-passing cohort (onlyQc, after steps 01-02)
onlyqc_fam = _try_csv(
    DATA_DIR / "onlyQc.fam",
    sep=r"\s+", header=None,
    names=["FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO"],
)
onlyqc_rc = set()
if onlyqc_fam is not None:
    # onlyQc IIDs are release_candid-based (from step 01 remapping)
    onlyqc_rc = set(
        pd.to_numeric(onlyqc_fam["IID"].astype(str).str[:-1], errors="coerce")
        .dropna().astype(int).unique()
    )
onlyqc_iids = rc_to_iids(onlyqc_rc)

# Stage 3 — Release cohort (hbcd, after steps 25-27)
release_fam = _try_csv(
    RELEASE_DIR / "hbcd.fam",
    sep=r"\s+", header=None,
    names=["FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO"],
)
release_rc = set()
if release_fam is not None:
    release_rc = set(
        release_fam.loc[release_fam["FID"] != 0, "FID"]
        .dropna().astype(int).unique()
    )
release_iids = rc_to_iids(release_rc)

# QC-removed = raw_rc - onlyqc_rc
qc_removed_rc = raw_rc - onlyqc_rc
qc_removed_iids = rc_to_iids(qc_removed_rc)

# ── Exclusion list data (for Venn panels) ──────────────────────────────

excl_csv = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "HBCDexclusions.csv")
excl_lists = {}
for col in excl_csv.columns:
    pscids = set(excl_csv[col].dropna().astype(str).str.strip())
    pscids = {p for p in pscids if p and p != "nan"}
    excl_lists[col] = pscids

# Map each exclusion list to RC and IID
excl_rc_lists = {}
excl_iids_lists = {}
for name, pscids in excl_lists.items():
    rc_set = set(
        identifiers.loc[identifiers["pscid"].isin(pscids), "release_candid"]
        .dropna().astype(int).unique()
    )
    excl_rc_lists[name] = rc_set
    excl_iids_lists[name] = rc_to_iids(rc_set)
```

```{python}
#| label: cardinality-overview
print("Pipeline Cascade (release_candid level)")
print("═" * 60)
print(f"  Raw HBCD cohort (July2025)      : {len(raw_rc):>6} RC")
print(f"  └─ QC + control removed         : {len(qc_removed_rc):>6} RC")
print(f"  onlyQc (derivatives base)       : {len(onlyqc_rc):>6} RC")
print(f"  └─ excluded (excel + csv)       : {len(all_exc_rc):>6} RC")
print(f"  Release set (hbcd.fam)          : {len(release_rc):>6} RC")
print()

print("Set sizes (IID level)")
print("═" * 60)
print(f"  Raw HBCD cohort                 : {len(raw_iids):>6}")
print(f"  onlyQc                          : {len(onlyqc_iids):>6}")
print(f"  Release (hbcd.fam)              : {len(release_iids):>6}")
print(f"  par_visit                       : {len(rc_to_iids(par_candids)):>6}")
print(f"  excluded (Excel)                : {len(rc_to_iids(exc_rc_excel)):>6}")
print(f"  excluded (HBCDexclusions.csv)   : {len(exc_pscids_csv):>6} pscids")
print(f"  → mapped to IID                 : {len(rc_to_iids(exc_rc_csv)):>6}")
print(f"  combined exclusions (IID)       : {len(all_exc_iids):>6}")
print()

print("IID-level pairwise overlaps (release set)")
print("═" * 60)
print(f"  onlyQc ∩ par_visit              : {len(onlyqc_iids & rc_to_iids(par_candids)):>6}")
print(f"  onlyQc ∩ release                : {len(onlyqc_iids & release_iids):>6}")
print(f"  par_visit ∩ release             : {len(rc_to_iids(par_candids) & release_iids):>6}")
```

---

## Pipeline Concept

```
  Raw HBCD cohort (1752 IIDs)
         │
         ▼  ─── Step 01-02: QC + control removal ───
         │
    ┌──── onlyQc ────┐  ←─ derivatives base (GRM, PCA, PC-Relate)
    │                  │
    │    Steps 03-24   │  Derivatives computed on FULL onlyQc set
    │  (GCTA/PLINK    │
    │   GRM, PC-AiR,  │
    │   PC-Relate,    │
    │   imputation)   │
    │                  │
    └────────┬─────────┘
             │
             ▼  ─── Step 25-27: par_visit + exclusion filtering ───
             │
          release ───► Step 28-29: subset derivatives to release
         (hbcd)                    subjects only
```

---

## Panel A: QC Filtering

How many subjects are removed by genomics QC and control filtering?

```{python}
#| label: venn-qc-removal
#| fig-cap: "QC removal: raw HBCD cohort vs onlyQc (IID level)"
if HAS_VENN:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
    v = venn2(
        subsets=(
            len(raw_iids - onlyqc_iids),
            len(onlyqc_iids - raw_iids),
            len(raw_iids & onlyqc_iids),
        ),
        set_labels=("Raw HBCD", "onlyQc (QC-pass)"),
        set_colors=["#1f78b4", "#33a02c"],
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_title("QC + Control Removal (IID level)", fontsize=13)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    ax.legend(
        handles=[
            Patch(facecolor="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, label=f"Raw ({len(raw_iids)})"),
            Patch(facecolor="#33a02c", alpha=0.5, label=f"QC-pass ({len(onlyqc_iids)})"),
        ],
        loc="lower left", fontsize=9,
    )
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("matplotlib-venn not available — skipping Venn diagram")
```

---

## Panel B: Release Filtering

From `onlyQc` to the release set: par_visit + exclusion filtering.

```{python}
#| label: venn-release-filter
#| fig-cap: "Release filtering: onlyQc ∩ par_visit minus exclusions (IID level)"
if HAS_VENN:
    par_iids = rc_to_iids(par_candids)
    subsets = (
        len(onlyqc_iids - par_iids - all_exc_iids),
        len(par_iids - onlyqc_iids - all_exc_iids),
        len((onlyqc_iids & par_iids) - all_exc_iids),
        len(all_exc_iids - onlyqc_iids - par_iids),
        len((onlyqc_iids & all_exc_iids) - par_iids),
        len((par_iids & all_exc_iids) - onlyqc_iids),
        len(onlyqc_iids & par_iids & all_exc_iids),
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
    v = venn3(
        subsets,
        set_labels=("onlyQc", "par_visit", "Excluded (IID)"),
        set_colors=["#33a02c", "#1f78b4", "#ff7f00"],
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_title("Release Filter (IID level)", fontsize=13)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    ax.legend(
        handles=[
            Patch(facecolor="#33a02c", alpha=0.5, label=f"onlyQc ({len(onlyqc_iids)})"),
            Patch(facecolor="#1f78b4", alpha=0.5, label=f"par_visit ({len(par_iids)})"),
            Patch(facecolor="#ff7f00", alpha=0.5, label=f"Excluded ({len(all_exc_iids)})"),
        ],
        loc="lower left", fontsize=9,
    )
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
else:
    print("matplotlib-venn not available — skipping Venn diagram")
```

**Interpretation**: The release set is `onlyQc ∩ par_visit` minus exclusions
(region in the centre of the Venn with onlyQc + par_visit, not in Excluded).

```{python}
#| label: release-count
print("Release subject derivation:")
print(f"  onlyQc subjects         : {len(onlyqc_iids):>6}")
print(f"  in par_visit            : {len(onlyqc_iids & par_iids):>6}")
print(f"    minus exclusions      : {len((onlyqc_iids & par_iids) - all_exc_iids):>6}")
print(f"  actual release IIDs     : {len(release_iids):>6}")
```

## Panel C: Exclusion Overlap

How many release_candids are shared across the three exclusion criteria?

```{python}
#| label: venn-exclusion-overlap
#| fig-cap: "RC-level overlap between the three exclusion sources"
if HAS_VENN and len(excl_lists) >= 3:
    lists_names = list(excl_lists.keys())[:3]
    s0 = excl_rc_lists[lists_names[0]]
    s1 = excl_rc_lists[lists_names[1]]
    s2 = excl_rc_lists[lists_names[2]]

    subsets = (
        len(s0 - s1 - s2),
        len(s1 - s0 - s2),
        len((s0 & s1) - s2),
        len(s2 - s0 - s1),
        len((s0 & s2) - s1),
        len((s1 & s2) - s0),
        len(s0 & s1 & s2),
    )

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
    v = venn3(
        subsets,
        set_labels=[n.split(":")[0] for n in lists_names],
        set_colors=["#1f78b4", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"],
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_title("Exclusion source overlap (release_candid)", fontsize=13)
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    handles = [
        Patch(facecolor=c, alpha=0.5, label=f"{n} ({len(excl_rc_lists[n])})")
        for n, c in zip(lists_names, ["#1f78b4", "#e31a1c", "#33a02c"])
    ]
    ax.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower left", fontsize=8)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
elif HAS_VENN:
    print(f"Need 3 exclusion lists, found {len(excl_lists)}")
else:
    print("matplotlib-venn not available — skipping Venn diagram")
```

```{python}
#| label: exclusion-table
print("Exclusion reason breakdown (release_candid level)")
print(f"{'Reason':<40} {'RCs':>6} {'in onlyQc':>9} {'in release':>10}")
print("─" * 68)
for name, rc_set in sorted(excl_rc_lists.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
    in_onlyqc = len(rc_set & onlyqc_rc)
    in_release = len(rc_set & release_rc)
    status = "OVERLAP" if in_release else "OK"
    print(f"  [{status:>7}] {name:<28} {len(rc_set):>6} {in_onlyqc:>9} {in_release:>10}")
print()

total_excel = len(exc_rc_excel)
total_csv = len(exc_rc_csv)
total = len(all_exc_rc)
in_onlyqc = len(all_exc_rc & onlyqc_rc)
in_release = len(all_exc_rc & release_rc)
print(f"  {'TOTAL (combined)':<40} {total:>6} {in_onlyqc:>9} {in_release:>10}")
```
